recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not add redundant prose for FHIR-20965; handle later final decisions such as FHIR-55300 separately if they enter an Applied/Published source-edit scope.
issue_request: FHIR-20965 was a Published PA Location change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to add a 0..* CodeableConcept Location.characteristic element, a search parameter, and an example value set for coded additional information such as wheelchair access, translation services, oxygen/nitrogen, negative pressure rooms, isolation ward, and ICU availability.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes location=Location, making source/location current build-scope resource source. Zulip and PA Confluence evidence match the HealthcareService-style characteristic/search approach. Later FHIR-55300 is only Resolved - change required and concerns future value-set renaming/migration, while FHIR-57431 is still Submitted and concerns a separate search-parameter rendering/target issue.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because current source already has Location.characteristic as 0..* CodeableConcept bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/location-characteristic, a token SearchParameter with expression Location.characteristic, example terminology containing the Jira-listed concepts, and an example Location using the wheelchair characteristic.
